summary: Artificial Intelligence Technology Solutions Inc. filed an 8-K to announce that its wholly owned subsidiary Robotic Assistance Devices Mobile (RAD-M) changed its name to PURSUON Inc. Articles of amendment were filed with Nevada on August 21, 2026. The filing explicitly states the change involves no new company, no ownership change, no capital structure change, and no securities issuance. It is purely a rebranding event with no special-situation financial or structural significance. Routine corporate naming change, not a transaction, no deal terms.
